earlier_attempts.name: attempt-1
earlier_attempts.explanation: The test clicked the native checkbox, which Nextcloud intentionally positions offscreen. Retested through its visible label.

earlier_attempts.name: attempt-2

failed.case: grant eligibility and Files read through the real matrix

earlier_attempts.explanation: The matrix defaults to eligible users. The new test account was absent until the Everyone filter was selected.

earlier_attempts.name: attempt-3

failed.case: real consent denial preserves the callback state

earlier_attempts.explanation: Playwright did not intercept the redirected callback; the app returned the expected 303 but the fixture had no listener. Replaced interception with a real loopback receiver.

earlier_attempts.name: attempt-4

failed.case: personal revoke removes the connection and rejects refresh

earlier_attempts.explanation: The revoke button accessible name includes the client name; the exact generic-name selector did not match.

earlier_attempts.name: attempt-5

failed.case: delete fixture client and disable service through UI

earlier_attempts.explanation: Same-document hash navigation retained a stale administrative snapshot. The server refused deletion with 409 and the UI explained the conflict. A real reload was required before asserting fresh state.

earlier_attempts.name: attempt-6

failed.case: no JavaScript exceptions or browser CSP violations

earlier_attempts.explanation: Firefox emitted Nextcloud/MCP initialization exceptions during a reload before the personal document finished loading.

earlier_attempts.name: attempt-7

failed.case: no JavaScript exceptions or browser CSP violations

earlier_attempts.explanation: The Firefox initialization exceptions reproduced with source stacks captured. Waiting for load before reload removed them without changing application code.

earlier_attempts.name: attempt-8
earlier_attempts.explanation: Focused Firefox retest passed after synchronizing the post-disconnect document load.

earlier_attempts.name: acceptance-final

failed.case: no JavaScript exceptions or browser CSP violations

earlier_attempts.explanation: WebKit emitted a Nextcloud notification access-control exception while leaving the initial dashboard with a cancelled request. The fixture now waits for initial network idle before navigation.

earlier_attempts.name: acceptance-complete

failed.case: personal revoke removes the connection and rejects refresh

earlier_attempts.explanation: Repeated intentional invalid-grant requests triggered Nextcloud brute-force protection: WebKit received 429 instead of the required 400. The 429 was not accepted as proof of revocation.

earlier_attempts.name: supplement-1

failed.case: resource scope restricts an empty selection and restores unrestricted

earlier_attempts.explanation: The independent scope readback omitted the session CSRF header and was correctly refused with 412. The browser scope save itself succeeded.

earlier_attempts.name: supplement-2

failed.case: access inspector renders actual server permission results

earlier_attempts.explanation: The inspector detailed table is intentionally collapsed; the test needed to open its disclosure before asserting visibility.

provisioning_first_attempt.result: Failed before installation: occ file existed while the image was still copying lib/versioncheck.php. Resumed the same owned resources after HTTP readiness; hidden password prompts completed successfully.

fixture_throttle_reset.reason: Repeated intentional invalid-grant assertions reached Nextcloud brute-force protection; HTTP 429 retained as failed oracle, not accepted as revocation proof. No configuration or protection was disabled.

server_logs.interpretation: One initial cron warning references the disabled FirstRunWizard background job. The final cron run succeeded and the warning count stayed one; no level 3/4 entries were recorded.
